card.title: I Made the Exception
card.instruction: Treat every exception you once arranged as an unpaid obligation. Casually expect cooperation whenever the old favor becomes relevant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I got your late job application accepted. You can take my Saturday shift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you've had the job for all of them. Saturday seems modest.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It took you one phone call.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then make one to the manager. Tell her you're covering Saturday; we'll call that even.

mechanism: A treats the exception secured for a late application as still owing cooperation and converts the one-call objection into a new call to cover Saturday.
confusable: Unlike invoking any past kindness, A's debt must arise from a specific exception arranged within a rule-governed process.
comparison: The shift alternative argues duration and equivalent effort; the treasurer alternative transfers an exception debt through a third person's nomination.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
